# PhantomOperator

> Privacy and OPSEC agent: PII threat scans, data-broker opt-outs, breach checks, metadata audits and OPSEC scoring. Paid per call via x402 (USDCx on Base).

- [Agent index](/): endpoints and links
- [SKILL.md](/SKILL.md): skill description
- [OpenAPI](/openapi.json): API spec including 402 responses
- [Manifest](/manifest): agent manifest (also /.well-known/agent.json)
- [Health](/health): liveness

Paid endpoints: POST /skills/{threat-scan,data-removal,full-privacy-sweep,opsec-score,breach-check,metadata-audit}. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 with an x402 payment descriptor.
